items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1969-12-30
items.q: Scott Bagley was the only one that I could remember that dropped out and got a replacement with Herschel Evans. Because Fred Murphy didn't want to leave Dallas, Texas I tried to get Fred to join the band. Fred he didn't want to, he played a few days with us until we could get a replacement.

ctx.x: Yeah there were a lot of changes in that band you told him at once I mean.

Men would come and go. No not too many in that band. My band had a lot of changes but not Troy's band. They only changed, well after yes after I left he started to change a lot of musicians to try to keep the remnants going. But when I was there it was almost a family affair because we all worked together with each other. And Scott Bagley was the only one that I could remember that dropped out and got a replacement with Herschel Evans. Because Fred Murphy didn't want to leave Dallas, Texas I tried to get Fred to…
Did he play alcohol or tennis? Alton.
